info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Procurement Detail Retrieval API
info.description: This API enables users to obtain detailed information about a specific procurement process identified by its unique ID. The endpoint serves as a crucial resource for stakeholders looking to track procurement activities, review status, and access associated documentation. Typical consumers include procurement managers, financial analysts, and compliance officers who rely on this data for informed decision-making and reporting. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance visibility into procurement workflows and streamline related operations.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details of a specific procurement resource identified by RES-100045. It provides comprehensive information related to the procurement activities associated with this resource.
